structural_change: The compactr3 failed the authoritative0.096um/0.60 pin-capacity audit before adoption. r4 returns to original388.8um face, and partitions each face clock into two actual half-face roots. Input control fields split at4SMs to preserve unique source-clock ownership. Body/core and one raw calendar clock are separate. Literal windows reserve all six clock entries; every data window cut<=0.60. Zero ordinary data/calendar stages added. Physical/native/typed grant still pending. f4db40 (Claude H-SM 1815): core clk CTS -distance_between_buffers 40 so no clock net strings an unbuffered ~110 um hop to the N-face cfg/desc capture row (c8e94d78d: 98 ps leaf vs 32 ps elsewhere -> 66 ps late flops -> 6 hold BUFx2 per input -> native capture 213.2 > 190). f4nc40 variant: also drops max-cap sink clustering (unclustered H-tree).
